get_breed_of_the_day.description: Pick one dog breed and one of its pictures for a date, and get the same answer every time that date is asked for. A workflow that runs every hour, or two workflows that post to different places, all agree on today's dog, and tomorrow brings a new one. Give a seed to have a different breed of the day from everyone else's. No API key required.

parameters.description: Optional. The day to pick the breed for. Leave it blank for today's date in UTC, which in the evening or early morning can be a day ahead of or behind yours; to follow your own time zone, pass in today's date from the workflow.
parameters.name: date

parameters.description: Optional. Any text you like. The same seed and date always give the same breed and picture; a different seed gives a different breed of the day, for a second channel or team, say.
parameters.name: seed

parameters.description: The breed to look for. Capitals and word order do not matter, so "Golden Retriever" and "retriever golden" find the same breed.
parameters.name: query

parameters.description: Optional. How many matches to return in this page. Between 1 and 100; 25 by default.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Optional. How many records to skip before this page. Use the next offset from the previous result to page through. 0 by default.
parameters.name: offset

count.description: How many records are in this page.

has_more.description: True when more records exist than this page holds.

matches.description: The matching breeds and sub-breeds in this page.

items.description: A matching breed or sub-breed, ready to feed another step.

breed.description: The breed's name as the Dog CEO API spells it: lowercase, one word, e.g. "hound". This is what the other actions take.

breed_slug.description: The breed and sub-breed joined the way an image URL writes them, e.g. "hound-afghan". Can be passed straight back in as the breed.

display_name.description: A readable name for the breed, e.g. "Afghan Hound".

is_sub_breed.description: True when this row names a sub-breed rather than a breed.

sub_breed.description: The sub-breed within that breed, e.g. "afghan". Null when the record is a whole breed rather than one of its varieties.

sub_breed_count.description: How many sub-breeds this breed has.

sub_breeds.description: The varieties within this breed, as their own names without the breed in front. Empty for a breed that has none.

next_offset.description: The offset that fetches the next page. Null when this is the last one.

query.description: The text that was searched for.

total_count.description: How many records there are in total, across every page.

description: Pull dog pictures and breed data into a workflow from the Dog CEO API: a random dog, a random pick from one breed or from several at once, or every picture of a breed a page at a time. Browse or search the full catalogue of over a hundred breeds and their sub-breeds, look one up to see how many pictures exist, pick a breed at random or a breed of the day that stays the same all day, and download a picture to post or attach. Every picture comes back with the breed it shows and alt text ready to caption it. No account or API key required.
